skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator of two fractions and rewrite both as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer parts of two numbers.

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction yields a negative result, decrease the whole part by 1 and increase the fraction numerator by the denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Normalize mixed number
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fraction part (numerator >= denominator) into a proper mixed number by carrying the excess to the whole part.
